title: Sonny and the Tiny Bilby | Bedtime Story
description: Join Sonny the Quokka on a gentle evening walk where she meets a tiny bilby emerging from her burrow at dusk, her enormous ears catching every soft sound of the night. A soothing bedtime story from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales, perfect for little ones drifting off to sleep.
narration:
The sky was turning deep and dark, and the first stars were blinking awake. Little Sonny padded softly through the quiet bush, her golden-brown fur warm in the moonlight. The grass whispered beneath her small, round feet.

Then something moved near the base of an old gum tree. A tiny nose appeared. Then two enormous ears — bigger than anything Sunny had ever seen — swivelled slowly in the cool night air.

It was a bilby. A tiny, perfect bilby, barely bigger than Sunny's paw. Her ears stood tall and wide, like two soft sails catching the breeze. She sniffed the air carefully, her long slender nose twitching left and right.

Sunny held very still. She did not want to scare the little bilby away. She breathed slowly. In and out. In and out.

The bilby's ears turned this way. Then that way. She could hear the creek trickling far away. She could hear a moth's wings brushing the moonlight. Her ears caught every tiny sound the night had to offer.

Sunny watched in wonder. She could almost feel the quietness of the bush through those great big ears. Everything felt more still. More peaceful. More soft.

Slowly, the bilby turned and looked at Sunny with bright little eyes. Then, satisfied and calm, she tucked herself back into the warmth of her burrow, her magnificent ears folding gently down.

Sunny smiled her warmest smile. She curled up near the old gum tree, the moon watching over them both.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, little bilby. Goodnight, little one.
